Daily totals, encrypted, for the days you choose
With the history off nothing is written to this phone and the lists are cleared when the phone restarts. With it on, one file of daily totals is kept for the chosen days. Events are never kept.
Delete the names and counts collected for this user, in memory and on this phone?
Company data: AdGuard Companies DB (CC BY-SA 4.0, built on whotracks.me, CC BY 4.0) and Wikidata (CC0), with facts from company filings. See NOTICE in the classifier.

Not seen: apps that look up names themselves (DNS over HTTPS inside the app), connections to a fixed address over UDP, and traffic that needs no lookup of its own. An app that is not listed may still be talking.
A connection that is not listed is not known. That is not proof that there is none.
